items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: had a deal, we were going to go overseas for the USO

ctx.x: Oh, we had a thing that we did in a strobe light, where we had some trick instruments that were painted with this substance that glows in the dark with a strobe light. Well, they would smear it on their nose and on their cheeks and they'd look like clowns up there, and everybody is laughing, you know, and oh, it was quite a scene. In fact, during the time there Dave [Schooler] called me and we

had a deal, we were going to go overseas for the USO, and I said, "Dave," I said, "these guys can't pass --," I'd have to come by for a physical is what he said, and I said, "Dave, these guys can't pass the physical. They're all 4-F." And he said, "Oh, this is nothing. All they've got to do is be breathing."
